```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# --- rats data preparation ---
rats_raw <- read.table("data/rats.txt", header = TRUE)

rats <-
  rats_raw |>
  mutate(
    treatment = fct_recode(
      factor(group, levels = c(2, 1, 3)),
      Control = "2",
      Low = "1",
      High = "3"
    ),
    subject = factor(subject)
  )

# --- Mesocosm data preparation ---
meso <- read_rds("data/Mesocosm_TA.rds")

# --- GAM demo for EDF ---
set.seed(42)
x <- seq(0, 10, length = 50)
y <- sin(x) + rnorm(50, sd = 0.3)

gam_wiggly <- gam(y ~ s(x, sp = 1e-4), method = "REML")
gam_smooth <- gam(y ~ s(x, sp = 100), method = "REML")

# --- LMM demo for shrinkage ---
sim_data <-
  tibble(
    group = factor(rep(1:5, each = 10)),
    y = rep(c(5, 8, 6, 9, 4), each = 10) + rnorm(50, sd = 1.5)
  )
m_lmer <- lmer(y ~ 1 + (1 | group), data = sim_data)
ranef_vals <- ranef(m_lmer)$group[[1]]
fixef_val <- fixef(m_lmer)[[1]]

# --- bs = re demo ---
demo_gam <- gam(Reaction ~ Days + s(Subject, bs = "re"),
                data = sleepstudy, method = "REML")
demo_lmer <- lmer(Reaction ~ Days + (1 | Subject), data = sleepstudy)
```



## 你将学到

::: incremental

- GAM 回顾：惩罚 → 收缩 → EDF
- LMM 回顾：随机效应的收缩
- 连接：平滑项 $\approx$ 随机效应
- 案例：用 `gam()` 拟合混合效应模型
  - `bs = "re"`：随机截距 + 随机斜率
  - `bs = "fs"`：因子-平滑交互
- `gamm()` / `gamm4()` 简介

:::



## GAM 回顾：惩罚 = 对"弯曲"收税

::: {.panel-tabset}

### λ 小 → 曲线弯曲

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(x, y) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x, y), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(x, fitted(gam_wiggly)), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "λ 小 → 曲线过度拟合数据")
```

### λ 大 → 曲线平滑

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(x, y) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x, y), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(x, fitted(gam_smooth)), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "λ 大 → 系数被压向零，曲线平滑")
```

:::

- GAM 在最大化对数似然的同时，减去 $\lambda \times$ **"弯曲度"**惩罚
- $\lambda$ 越大，惩罚越重，系数越被压向零 → 曲线越平滑



## EDF 衡量收缩程度

- **EDF（有效自由度）**：衡量一个平滑项实际用了多少"弯曲能力"
- EDF $\approx$ 1：接近直线（强收缩）
- EDF $\approx$ $k-1$：接近插值（几乎无收缩）
- EDF 介于之间：部分收缩

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(
  lambda = c("1e-4", "0.1", "1", "10", "100"),
  edf = c(
    summary(gam_wiggly)$edf,
    summary(gam(y ~ s(x, sp = 0.1), method = "REML"))$edf,
    summary(gam(y ~ s(x, sp = 1), method = "REML"))$edf,
    summary(gam(y ~ s(x, sp = 10), method = "REML"))$edf,
    summary(gam_smooth)$edf
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("λ", "EDF"))
```

- 这个"收缩"机制——把估计向某个方向压——与随机效应的收缩**本质相同**



## LMM 回顾：固定效应 vs 随机效应

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 固定效应：无收缩

```{r}
#| echo: false
sim_data |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(m = mean(y)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(sim_data$y), linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(group, m), size = 3, color = "red") +
  ylim(2, 12) +
  labs(
    title = "固定效应：各组均值独立估计",
    subtitle = "无收缩，各组完全自由"
  )
```

### 随机效应：有收缩

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(
  group = factor(1:5),
  blup = fixef_val + ranef_vals,
  raw_mean = sim_data |> group_by(group) |> summarise(m = mean(y)) |> pull(m)
) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = fixef_val, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(group, raw_mean), size = 3, color = "red", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(group, blup), size = 3, color = "blue") +
  ylim(2, 12) +
  labs(
    title = "随机效应：各组向总体均值收缩",
    subtitle = "蓝色 = 收缩后估计，红色（淡）= 原始组均值"
  )
```

:::

- 随机效应 = 各组的估计被"拉回"总体均值
- **组方差小 → 拉回力度大（收缩强）；组方差大 → 拉回力度小（收缩弱）**



## 连接：平滑项 ≈ 随机效应

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-align: center

p_gam <-
  tibble(x, y) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x, y), alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(x, fitted(gam_wiggly), color = "λ 小（wiggly）"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(x, fitted(gam_smooth), color = "λ 大（smooth）"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("λ 小（wiggly）" = "red",
                                 "λ 大（smooth）" = "blue")) +
  labs(title = "GAM：λ 控制平滑曲线弯曲程度",
       color = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_lmm <-
  sim_data |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(raw = mean(y)) |>
  mutate(shrunken = fixef_val + ranef(m_lmer)$group[[1]]) |>
  pivot_longer(c(raw, shrunken), names_to = "type", values_to = "mean") |>
  mutate(type = fct_recode(type,
                           "原始组均值" = "raw",
                           "收缩后（BLUP）" = "shrunken")) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(group, mean, color = type), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = fixef_val, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("原始组均值" = "red",
                                 "收缩后（BLUP）" = "blue")) +
  labs(title = "LMM：组方差控制随机效应收缩",
       color = NULL,
       x = "group") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_gam | p_lmm
```

- **左图**：GAM 中 $\lambda$ 控制平滑曲线的收缩
- **右图**：LMM 中组方差控制随机效应的收缩
- **本质相同**：都是通过一个"收缩参数"控制估计被压向零/总均值的力度



## `bs = "re"` 怎么用

::: {.panel-tabset}

### `gam()` 写法

```{r}
gam(Reaction ~ Days + s(Subject, bs = "re"),
    data = sleepstudy, method = "REML")
```

- `s(subject, bs = "re")` = 随机截距：每个 subject 一个基函数，单位阵惩罚
- `s(subject, x, bs = "re")` = 随机斜率：每个 subject 对 x 的斜率随机

### `lmer()` 写法

```{r}
lmer(Reaction ~ Days + (1 | Subject), data = sleepstudy)
```

:::




## GAMM 在R中的不同实现方式对比

| 方案 | 非高斯族 | 大规模 RE | 额外功能 |
|------|----------|-----------|----------|
| `gam()` + `bs = "re"` | ✅ 扩展家族 | ❌ 慢 | — |
| `gamm()` | ⚠️ PQL | 中等 | 相关结构 / 异方差 |
| `gamm4()` | ⚠️ PQL | ✅ 高效 | — |

# 案例一：rats 数据

## 大鼠实验数据[^1]

[^1]: 数据来源：[https://www.uni-goettingen.de/de/551625.html](https://www.uni-goettingen.de/de/551625.html)

- 大鼠随机分配到 3 个处理组：Control、Low、High
- 第 50 天开始测量头部高度（response），共 7 个时间点
- 时间变量 `transf_time` = $\log(1 + (\text{time} - 45) / 10)$

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 数据表

```{r}
#| echo: false
rats |>
  select(subject, treatment, time, transf_time, response) |>
  head(10) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### 时序图 I

```{r}
#| echo: false
rats |>
  ggplot(aes(time, response, group = subject, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment, ncol = 3) +
  labs(y = "Head height (pixels)", x = "Age (days)")
```

### 时序图 II
```{r}
#| echo: false
rats |>
  ggplot(aes(transf_time, response, group = subject, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment, ncol = 3) +
  labs(y = "Head height (pixels)", x = "Transformed time")

```
:::



## 模型 1：随机截距

```{r}
#| warning: true
gam_ri <- gam(response ~ treatment:transf_time + s(subject, bs = "re"),
              data = rats, method = "REML")

lmer_ri <- lmer(response ~ treatment:transf_time + (1 | subject),
                data = rats)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 固定效应对比

```{r}
#| echo: false
tribble(
  ~ 项, ~ gam, ~ lmer,
  "(Intercept)", coef(gam_ri)[[1]] |> round(3), fixef(lmer_ri)[[1]] |> round(3),
  "Control:transf_time", coef(gam_ri)[[2]] |> round(3), fixef(lmer_ri)[[2]] |> round(3),
  "Low:transf_time", coef(gam_ri)[[3]] |> round(3), fixef(lmer_ri)[[3]] |> round(3),
  "High:transf_time", coef(gam_ri)[[4]] |> round(3), fixef(lmer_ri)[[4]] |> round(3)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### 方差组分对比

- `lmer()`:
```{r}
summary(lmer_ri)$varcor
```
- `gam()`:
```{r}
variance_comp(gam_ri)
```

:::

- 系数几乎完全一致！方差组分也几乎一致！



## 模型 2：加入随机斜率

```{r}
gam_rs <- gam(response ~ treatment:transf_time +
                s(subject, bs = "re") +
                s(subject, transf_time, bs = "re"),
              data = rats, method = "REML")
lmer_rs <- lmer(response ~ treatment:transf_time +
                  (1 | subject) + (0 + transf_time | subject),
                data = rats)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 方差组分

- `lmer()`:
```{r}
summary(lmer_rs)$varcor
```
- `gam()`:
```{r}
variance_comp(gam_rs)

```


### EDF：收缩程度

```{r}
#| echo: false
edf_tab <-
  edf(gam_rs) |>
  mutate(收缩 = if_else(.edf < 1, "强收缩（≈ 0）", "弱收缩"))

knitr::kable(edf_tab)
```

### 随机效应显著性检验

```{r}
summary(gam_rs)
```

:::

- 随机斜率的 EDF ≈ 0：说明几乎没有大鼠间的时间斜率变异
- `lmer()` 给出了 singular fit 警告，对应一致



## 两模型比较

```{r}
AIC(gam_ri, gam_rs)
```

- AIC 几乎相同 → 随机斜率项冗余
- 这与 EDF 接近 0 及 `lmer()` singular fit 警告一致
- 用 `gam()` 拟合随机效应的好处之一：EDF 直接告诉你哪些随机项被强烈收缩



## 绘制模型拟合曲线

```{r}
#| echo: false
new_data <-
  tidyr::expand(rats, nesting(subject, treatment),
                transf_time = unique(transf_time))

m1_pred <-
  bind_cols(new_data,
            as.data.frame(predict(gam_ri, newdata = new_data,
                                  se.fit = TRUE)))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r}
m1_pred |>
  filter(treatment == "Control") |>
  ggplot(aes(transf_time, fit)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = rats|> filter(treatment == "Control"), aes(transf_time, response), alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ subject, ncol = 6) +
  labs(y = "Fitted head height (pixels)", x = "Transformed time")
```



# 案例二：Mesocosm TA 数据

## 背景介绍

中尺度围隔实验：

![](images/FOANIC-XMU-old.jpg){width=80%}

## 中尺度围隔实验数据

- 8 个实验袋（Bag），分两种 CO₂ 处理（AC = 对照 / HC = 酸化）
- 测量**总碱度（TA）**随时间的变化，实验分 4 个阶段（Stage）
- 每个 Bag 有多次重复测量 → Bag 是合理的随机因子

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 数据表

```{r}
#| echo: false
meso |>
  select(Bag, Treatment, Day, TA, Stage) |>
  head(10) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### TA 原始时序

```{r}
#| echo: false
meso |>
  ggplot(aes(Day, TA, color = Treatment, group = Bag)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(y = "TA (µM)", x = "Day")
```

:::

- 问题：不同 Bag 的 TA 随时间如何变化？AC 与 HC 处理间有无显著差异？



## 探索性分析：分组均值趋势

- 实验分为 4 个阶段，每个阶段有营养盐添加操作

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: "center"
ta_summary <-
    meso |>
    group_by(Treatment, Day, Stage) |>
    summarise(
        TA_mean = mean(TA, na.rm = TRUE),
        TA_sd = sd(TA, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

ta_summary |>
    ggplot(aes(Day, TA_mean, color = Treatment)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = TA_mean - TA_sd, ymax = TA_mean + TA_sd),
        width = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_line(aes(group = interaction(Treatment, Stage))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(8, 16, 20, 32), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
        y = "TA (µM)", x = "Day",
        title = "各处理组 TA 均值 ± SD（虚线 = 阶段切换）"
    ) +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
```





## 模型 1：不含随机效应的 GAM

```{r}
ta_gam0 <- gam(TA ~ s(Day) + Treatment + Stage,
               data = meso, method = "REML")
```

```{r}
summary(ta_gam0)
```

## 模型 2：含因子-平滑交互的 GAMM

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 模型拟合
```{r}
ta_gam1 <- gam(TA ~ s(Day) + Treatment + Stage +
                 s(Bag, Day, bs = "fs", m = 1),
               data = meso, method = "REML")
```


### 模型摘要

```{r}
summary(ta_gam1)
```

### 平滑项图

```{r}
plot(ta_gam1, page = 1, scheme = 1)
```

- `s(Bag, Day, bs = "fs", m = 1)`：每个 Bag 有自己的 Day 平滑，共享惩罚参数

### AIC比较
对比模型 1 和 2 的 AIC：

```{r}
AIC(ta_gam0, ta_gam1)
```

- AIC 大幅下降 → 随机效应必要

:::

## 模型 3：分组趋势比较

允许 AC 和 HC 各自有独立的 Day 平滑趋势：

```{r}
ta_gam2 <- gam(TA ~ s(Day, by = Treatment) + Treatment + Stage +
                 s(Bag, Day, bs = "fs", m = 1),
               data = meso, method = "REML")
```

```{r}
summary(ta_gam2)
```

## AC 与 HC 的 TA 差异何时显著？

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 数据处理

```{r}
ta_diff <-
  get_difference(ta_gam2,
                 comp = list(Treatment = c("HC", "AC")),
                 cond = list(Day = seq(0, 36, length = 100),
                             Stage = factor(1, levels = 1:4)),
                 rm.ranef = TRUE)
```

### 绘图代码

```{r}
#| eval: false
ta_diff |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(Day, difference)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = Day, y = difference,
                  ymax = difference + CI,
                  ymin = difference - CI),
              fill = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(y = "TA difference (HC − AC) (µM)", x = "Day",
       title = "AC 与 HC 处理组的 TA 差异")
```

### 结果图

```{r}
#| echo: false
ta_diff |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(Day, difference)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = Day, y = difference,
                  ymax = difference + CI,
                  ymin = difference - CI),
              fill = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(y = "TA difference (HC − AC) (µM)", x = "Day",
       title = "AC 与 HC 处理组的 TA 差异")
```

:::


## 模型比较与选择

```{r}
#| echo: false
tribble(
  ~模型, ~描述, ~AIC,
  "ta_gam0", "仅固定效应：s(Day) + Treatment + Stage",
    AIC(ta_gam0) |> round(1),
  "ta_gam1", "含 fs 随机效应",
    AIC(ta_gam1) |> round(1),
  "ta_gam2", "分组平滑 + fs 随机效应",
    AIC(ta_gam2) |> round(1)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```


# 总结

## 核心要点

::: incremental

- GAM 的惩罚项与 LMM 的随机效应共享相同的收缩机制
- `s(subject, bs = "re")` 等价于 `(1 | subject)`
- `s(subject, x, bs = "re")` 等价于 `(0 + x | subject)`
- `s(factor, x, bs = "fs")` 为每个因子水平拟合相似的平滑趋势
- `gam()` 拟合混合效应模型的优势：
  - 统一框架：平滑 + 随机效应 + 非高斯族
  - EDF 直接显示收缩程度
  - 随机效应的显著性检验（Wood 2013）

:::
